text_block_list.text:
After winning the Radio NIKKEI Sho, a 
haughty girl suddenly came up and spoke to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O, hold it right there! 
You're a fan of my sister, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm a huge fan of Maruzensky-oneesama! 
I've been following her around for three 
whole months now!

Even so, it doesn't seem like the girl 
poses any danger to Sakura Chiyono O. 
Deciding to keep watch for now...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
You show promise. After all, you took 1st 
place in the race that my older sister 
once won.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Did you happen to watch my Asahi Hai 
FS too?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not just the Asahi Hai FS. The 
Tokyo Sports Hai Junior Stakes, and now 
this Radio NIKKEI Sho...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Those races are the ones where 
Maruzen-san took 1st place, and I took 1st 
place too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see... I can tell that you are also a 
true, dyed-in-the-wool Maruzen fan! Let us 
converse to our hearts' content!!

"...And before we knew it, the three of us 
were sitting around a table at a ramen 
shop."

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp*... *nom nom*... ...And before you 
knew it, you were cheering too. Her run in 
this race was pretty good, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you very much! I felt pretty 
good about how I did today myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I thought that maybe, just like 
Maruzen-san, I had grasped the secret of 
the mile...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Well... everything leads back to 
Onee-sama! Just as I thought, your resolve 
is on a whole other level compared to 
ordinary fans!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
And then we enter the Sapporo sprint and 
finish strong. And that's the best ending, 
right? Fufu, I'd gladly make you my very 
first fellow fan—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's far too early to call it a day. 
My current goal is the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
after all. ...And also so I can become a 
true rival to Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute. ...Rivals? No way. Are you 
planning on becoming Onee-sama's enemy?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Um, I'm sorry. I might have given 
you the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to just be Maruzen-san's 
fan, I want to be her rival."

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean...? I mean, you love 
Onee-sama, don't you? You look up to her, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I love it. ...That is precisely why I 
want to be recognized as a rival.
choice_data_list:
That's why you work so hard every day, 
right?

That's why you work so hard every day, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. As you know, Maruzen-san's running 
is overwhelming. In comparison, my running 
must seem mediocre."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yet I swore never to give up on myself, no 
matter who I am, and that is why I stand 
here in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to show the strongest 
run I can in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), and 
light a fire in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then it seems you and I won't be 
becoming fellow fans anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"It may be a different form of love than 
the one I hold for dear Sister, but if 
that is the form yours takes, then..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The ramen was really delicious! Um...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose I can acknowledge you as my 
big sister's rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I acknowledged you as 
Onee-sama's rival! Because you've got real 
talent, and you try your hardest!!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
So become Onee-sama's greatest adversary! 
Get stronger by the exact measure of your 
love, and deliver those feelings straight 
to Onee-sama!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: I'm cheering for Chiyono O too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. To think that Maruzen-san's fans 
would acknowledge me as her rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...It's truly an honor.

Sakura Chiyono O kept bowing deeply to the 
girl who was running away.
